'''April 2001 Belle Mead tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Only Game In Town, Belle Mead, NJ on 29 April 2001. It is known from Greg Shaw's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2214">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-01-dwarf-invasion-belle-mead-nj-4-29d2214/ dwarf-invasion-belle-mead-nj-4-29], DeckTech (Greg "TychoCelchu" Shaw, 1 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-01-dwarf-invasion-belle-mead-nj-4-29d2214/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 April 2001
* '''Site:''' The Only Game In Town, Belle Mead, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
